description:
Chartquery generates charts, diagrams, QR codes, barcodes, and labels from ChatGPT. Describe the data or payload and get a public render URL you can open.

Charts: AI chart from a brief, or a structured chart payload. Diagrams: AI flowchart or a structured diagram. Codes: QR for URLs and Code128 barcodes. Labels: preview, parse, validate, convert, compile. Visual tools return https://api.chartquery.com/v1/{kind}/render/{id}?utm_source=chatgpt.com. Show that URL.

Sign in with your Chartquery account when you connect. Calls use the same credits and quotas as app.chartquery.com.

defaultPrompt: Create a bar chart of Q1 revenue: Jan 12, Feb 15, Mar 9.
Generate a QR code for https://example.com
Make a simple flowchart: start, review, done.
